mlag.note: Two-chassis active-active LAG with load balancing; separate from stacking

stacking.note: Up to 8x 40/100G QSFP28 as stack ports, 12 members, up to 10 km, ISSU. Aggregate stack bandwidth up to 9.6 Tbps

routing.summary: Base: static and RIP. Premium (ICX7850-PREM-LIC): OSPF, BGP, VRRP, PIM, PBR, VRF, GRE, BGP EVPN VXLAN

routeScale: Up to 128,000 IPv4 / 7,000 IPv6 routes; 20,000 next hops

power.summary: Dual hot-swap 650W AC/DC (RPS19), reversible airflow; 5 or 6 hot-swap fans

licensing: ICX7850-PREM-LIC for advanced L3; ICX-MACSEC-LIC for MACsec on -48FS. Bare SKUs need PSU/fans ordered separately; -E2 bundles include dual PSU and fans
verifyNote: Packet buffer size is not stated on the ICX 7850 datasheet
note: Accessories: RPS19-E/I, RPS19DC-E/I, ICX-FAN12-E/I. Optics: ruckus-optics (E40G-/E100G-QSFP28 and 25G SFP28)

models.note: All 32 QSFP28 ports are 40/100G; up to 8 rightmost usable for stacking. Breakout to 4x10/25G supported
MACsec and LRM on the 48x 1/10G SFP+ ports with ICX-MACSEC-LIC
